model_output:
```sql
WITH bessemer_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Bessemer'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Pennsylvania'
    AND addr_county ILIKE 'Lawrence'
)
SELECT MAX(rast_val) AS highest_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, b.geom, TRUE))).max AS rast_val
  FROM public.dem_us r, bessemer_geom b
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, b.geom)
) subquery;
```
